name: Elixir of Suffering
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon tests a new draught for the Royal Apothecary Society. The Society seeks a plague that will kill living humans and the Scourge.

sections.title: Apothecary Experimentation
sections.body: Around ruined Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon gathers raw reagents from the wilderness and mixes them into toxic draughts. His work follows the Royal Apothecary Society's charge to devise a plague that will exterminate the living and the dead alike. To test one brew, Lydon gives it to Umpi, his frog assistant.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Elixir of Suffering?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon brews the elixir as an experiment for the Royal Apothecary Society. The Society seeks a plague to eradicate living humans and the Scourge.
Umpi is a frog kept by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill. Lydon calls Umpi his assistant, but the frog is an unwitting test subject for his newly brewed toxins.

faq.q: What happens when Umpi drinks the elixir?
faq.answer: When Umpi drinks the Elixir of Suffering, the frog croaks and almost at once succumbs to the poison. The test reveals how deadly Lydon's brew is.

angles.text: Across Lordaeron, the Royal Apothecary Society works to make a weapon that will secure the Forsaken's independence from the Scourge and living humanity. Lydon's experiments in Tarren Mill are part of that work.
